Business_Definition: Count of appeals received in the reporting period
Formula: COUNT(Appeal_ID) WHERE Received_Date BETWEEN period start AND end

Business_Definition: Count of appeals not closed as of the reporting date
Formula: COUNT(Appeal_ID) WHERE Status <> 'Closed' AS OF reporting date

Business_Definition: Median calendar days from receipt to closure for closed appeals
Closed appeals meeting the SLA target divided by closed appeals
Appeals resolved without reassignment divided by all appeals
Appeals requiring rework divided by all appeals
